Subject — Incident report - booking API outage on 12 January

Hi Carlos,

Please find attached the incident report for the booking API outage on the evening of 12 January. I want to apologise again for the disruption to your customers.

In short, the root cause was an expired certificate on the load balancer in front of the booking API. Our engineers identified and replaced it within 25 minutes, and it took a further 15 minutes to drain the queued requests, so the total impact was around 40 minutes.

To stop this happening again, we are adding automated certificate expiry monitoring across every load balancer we manage for Wingtip, with alerts 30, 14 and 3 days before expiry. That work will be finished by the end of next week.

I am happy to walk you or your team through the timeline on a call if that would help.

Best regards,
[Your name]

Subject — Crew app slowness - cause found and fix scheduled

Hi Lars,

Thank you for your patience while we looked into the slow crew app in the mornings. We have found the cause.

The roster sync job runs at 6am and locks part of the database while it updates, which is exactly when your crews are logging in to check their schedules. That is why the slowness is concentrated between 6 and 8am.

From this Thursday we will move the sync job to 3am, when usage is at its lowest. We will monitor response times every morning for a week and send you a short summary at the end of it.

If your crews notice any change, good or bad, please let us know so we can compare it with what we see in the monitoring.

Best regards,
[Your name]

**Summary**
- We propose to migrate Proseware's customer data from the legacy CRM to the new platform in 10 weeks, for a fixed price of $95,000.
- The work runs in five phases - data profiling, mapping, test migrations, cutover and two weeks of hypercare - with a sign-off by Proseware at the end of each phase.
- Because data quality in the legacy CRM is not yet known, we will absorb the cost of cleaning duplicate records up to 15% of the total. Above that level, we will agree the extra effort with you through a change request before any work starts.
- Proseware will provide a named data owner, read access to the legacy CRM from week one, and timely sign-off at each test migration.
- At the end of the project, all active customer records will be on the new platform, reconciled against the source, with a full audit trail of what was migrated, merged or archived.
